quickTags: Leading cause of viral encephalitis in Asia
genZNote: Pigs and wading birds keep this virus circulating in the background — humans are usually just accidental, dead-end hosts.

habitat.naturalHabitat: Maintained in a transmission cycle between Culex mosquitoes and amplifying hosts (pigs and wading birds)
habitat.hostAssociation: Humans are incidental, dead-end hosts — human viremia is not high enough to further infect mosquitoes
habitat.reservoir: Pigs and wading birds (amplifying hosts); Culex mosquitoes maintain and transmit the virus

identificationClues: Diagnosed primarily by serology (IgM ELISA on serum or CSF), since viremia is often low/brief by the time of presentation
Rural, agricultural settings in Asia with rice paddies and pig farming are the classic epidemiologic setting
Most infections are asymptomatic, but symptomatic cases can be severe, with high mortality and significant neurological sequelae among survivors
Effective vaccines exist and are recommended for long-term travelers/residents of endemic rural areas

diseases: Japanese encephalitis — the leading cause of viral encephalitis in Asia; most infections are asymptomatic, but symptomatic disease can cause high fever, seizures, and altered mental status with a high case-fatality rate and frequent long-term neurological sequelae among survivors
clinicalImportance.transmission: Bite of an infected Culex mosquito, particularly in rural agricultural (rice paddy, pig farming) areas of Asia
clinicalImportance.epidemiology: The leading cause of viral encephalitis across many parts of Asia; incidence has declined substantially in countries that have implemented routine childhood vaccination programs
clinicalImportance.labSignificance: IgM ELISA on serum or cerebrospinal fluid is the mainstay of diagnosis, given that viremia is typically too low or transient for reliable RT-PCR detection by the time of clinical presentation

examFacts.keyBiochemicalReaction: Not applicable — diagnosed by IgM serology
examFacts.importantDisease: Japanese encephalitis — leading cause of viral encephalitis in Asia
examFacts.distinguishingFeature: A Culex-transmitted flavivirus maintained by pigs and wading birds, and the leading cause of viral encephalitis across Asia
